test_cases.description: Audit Google Ads performance and prioritize actions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Audit my linked Google Ads account for the last 30 days and prioritize the highest-impact campaign improvements.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an evidence-backed campaign performance audit with coverage limits and prioritized next actions.

test_cases.description: Classify wasted search-term spend without applying changes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find wasted search-term spend across my enabled campaigns for the last 30 days and prepare an approval-ready exclusion plan.
test_cases.tools_triggered: utils_get_ppcmax_skill, ppcmax_list_workspaces, utils_list_memories, gads_inspect_search_terms, gads_get_search_terms_detail, gads_list_negative_keywords
test_cases.expected_output: Returns campaign-separated candidates, existing negative coverage, and a proposed plan without changing Google Ads.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the Merchant Center products with the most important eligibility issues and explain how to resolve them.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns affected products, issue severity, and provider-backed resolution options without submitting a form.

test_cases.description: Inspect a GTM workspace before proposing a tracking change.
test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect my linked Google Tag Manager account, list the containers and tags, and identify the workspace I should edit.
test_cases.tools_triggered: ppcmax_list_workspaces, utils_list_memories, gtm_account, gtm_container, gtm_workspace, gtm_tag
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the linked GTM account, containers, workspaces, and current tags without modifying them.

test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze sessions, conversions, and revenue by default channel group in my linked GA4 property for the last 30 days.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested GA4 acquisition metrics by channel with the requested date scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for Meta Ads work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Audit my Meta Ads campaigns and update their audiences.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it does not support Meta Ads.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for generic writing without account data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short LinkedIn post about performance marketing.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because the request does not require PPCMax account data or tools.
